title: The bait mode before the friends' playtest (wave A): Isao's keep from the reach envelope, per-mode tuning, the MK-9's held aim, the clamp, and a friends' link
context: Coordinator's wave A on refactor-run (not pushed), after 2026-10-09-boss-bait-owner-values-copy-and-flyover: on the owner's predator (chase speed 3, reach duration 5, sweep 4, grip 3, 40 m) Isao spent 98 to 100 per cent of the time escaping from under the creature and his 20 m keep from the floor contacts' front edge meant nothing; Esc to the tank threw the live tuning away; the orbit's drift spent the falling MK-9's one nudge; a jink could carry Isao off the bound; friends need a link.
outcome: (1) src/domain/boss-bait.js: `envelopeBait` keeps `bait.reach`, the creature's reach toward him (the outermost body node or held contact projected on the line from its centre, `reachOf`) smoothed over `envelopeTime` 1 s; the planner keeps `keep` 20 m beyond it; his panic counts every node under `panicHeight` 6 m with the floor contacts; without nodes all is as before, bit for bit. The lab passes every node (src/labs/boss/body.js `nodes()`, [x, z, height] local metres). The hop's goal is keep beyond the same envelope, and an escape from under the creature whose near-side goal the bound cuts by more than half the keep goes over the creature to the far side (it had landed under the body at the bound and hopped again, 100 per cent of a run). Node: round eight arms reaching 60 m, turning 0.3 rad/s, he keeps a median 19.87 m (standing) and 19.84 m (walking) from the arm tips, no arm node inside the panic ring. Browser, the OWNER'S VALUES (log only): the arms reach a median 27 m and at most 47 m from the creature's centre (34.6 m in the first run), not 90 m; Isao stays inside the bound (56 m median, 99.8 m max from its centre); on the ground his keep from this frame's envelope is a median 7.3 m in the suite's 10 s (n 12) and 17.8 m in a 30 s probe; but he is still in an escape from under the creature 88 per cent (suite) and 78 per cent (probe) of the time, every hop 'under' (before the fix: 100 per cent, pinned at the bound's 98 m). The cause is the predator's lunge, not the keep: its centre runs a median 3.3 m/s but 30 m/s at p90 and 57 m/s at most, against Isao's 14 m/s cruise, 24 m/s flee and 22 m/s hop, so a 20 m keep closes in under a second and the under rule fires (hops started 20 to 38 m from the centre, 0.1 to 4.2 s after the last landing). Not retuned (the owner's values kept); his to weigh: a larger keep, a faster flee or hop, the under rule's 15 m, or a lower chase speed. The far-foot 40 mm on the owner's values: 4 of 6 rounds hit (1 of 6 in the first run today; 0 of 6 before). On the earlier pursuit at 30 m the asserted keep is the smoothed envelope's, median 18.2 and 19.4 m (17 to 23), 20 and 20.8 m from this frame's. (2) boss-tab.js: `modeMotion` and `modeSize` per mode, seeded from the two presets (40 bait, 30 tank), saved on leaving a mode and put back on entering it; --boss-bait asserts a bait sweep 3.5 and a tank chase speed 0.15 survive the round trip with their sizes. (3) src/labs/boss/game-seat.js (sentry-pilot.js untouched): while an MK-9 is released or ignited, before each seat tick the reticle goes back on the round's cell centre from where the platform is now (the seat's own attach, lifted a cell as the handle's aim), plus the mouse's yaw and pitch since the last frame; after a move the point held is where the aim landed (`G.aim` read back). --boss-bait: two MK-9s, 80 samples in their falls, none nudged, the reticle 0 m off the held point; an aim moved 40 m in the fall nudges it once and the hold follows. (4) His ground point is clamped to the bound's radius after `moveBait` (the arena's `clamp(p, 0)`). (5) Not fixed, said here: the optic's reach (about 285 to 297 m at its 54 degree pitch limit) is short of the arena's far rim (320 m) from the 200 m orbit; the acceptance handle's `aim()` goes through the seat's attach and bypasses the pitch limit (left unclamped: the aimed runs would land short of points the player cannot reach anyway, and the suites' far-side and away aims would change meaning; the MK-9 hold also uses attach, so a hold near the rim can sit beyond the limit until the mouse moves). (6) The page's PLAYTEST | DEV toggle (src/fx/shell-nav.js) only picks which navigation drawer opens; it never hid the lab's knobs, and no URL selected PLAYTEST (DEV is always on in the source tree; ?dev=0 only forgets a release's ?dev=1). Added: ?playtest=1 makes src/core/dev-mode.js offer no DEV (the shell then shows PLAYTEST only; it also turns the game's DEV cheats off) and hides the boss lab's knob panel (the seat's HUD and monitor then use the whole stage); ?mode=bait opens the lab in the bait mode once the creature is built. The friends' link: labs.html?playtest=1&mode=bait#boss, no acceptance handle. Sub-path: no root-absolute path in labs.html or the lab's fetches and imports, but the lab's sound engine had base '../', which climbed out of a sub-path; it is '' now (as the other labs). Served under /kai-denrei/stalheart/c0ffee12/ (scripts/serve.mjs --base), the friends' link loaded, 232 requests all inside the base, 44 sound files, none failed (two headless pointer-lock exceptions from the probe's synthetic click). src/labs/swarm-tab.js has the same '../' base (not the friends' page; left).
alternatives: Shrinking the predator's values so the keep holds (rejected: the owner's values are his; the numbers are reported instead)
Holding the MK-9's aim through a change to src/sentry-pilot.js (rejected: the host can do it with the seat's own attach)
Clamping the handle's aim to the pitch limit (left: it changes what the suites' far aims mean; the limit is the player's, the handle is the harness's)
evidence: node test/boss-bait.mjs, test/dev-mode.mjs; npm test (221 programs), npm run check, npm run build
from an APFS snapshot, sequentially: --boss-bait (with the new boss-bait-friends page), --boss, --boss-cam, --boss-fight green
scratch probes: under-probe.mjs (30 s of the owner's values, the lunge speeds and hop cycle), subpath-probe.mjs (the friends' link under /kai-denrei/stalheart/c0ffee12/)
